methodology.registry: Local warmed mirror; upstream tarball URLs pinned by original locks can bypass it.
methodology.scripts: disabled during timed installs; project build/check follows
methodology.cold: native tool lock, empty private PM cache/store and node_modules; OS and registry caches retained
methodology.warm: native tool lock and populated PM cache/store, node_modules removed
methodology.noop: native tool lock, caches and installed tree retained
methodology.migration: untimed preparation from pristine committed original lock; migration may fall back to fresh resolution, recorded in warnings; timed installs use each tool's resulting native lock
methodology.disk: st_blocks*512, unique device/inode across all node_modules and private PM state before project builds; hardlinks counted once; reflink extents not identified.
methodology.declarations: dependencies and devDependencies must resolve through importer ancestors; foreign OS/CPU entries are excluded only when the tool text lock explicitly declares that restriction; all exclusions are retained
methodology.timeoutPolicy: Uncapped installs and verification; earlier capped attempts are preserved under priorCappedScenarios and prior-capped logs. Only previously timed-out cold scenarios are remeasured; successful baselines retain their original samples.
methodology.verification: Restore pristine source and tool lock, install with scripts disabled, audit declarations and package-set stability, then run the listed direct project check.
